Fraction.description: How much of the whole run is finished, 0 to 1.

file.description: The source file the stage is working on, as it was given.

message.description: One line for a person to read; on error, what went wrong.

download.description: A model or program downloading on its first use, while it downloads: a model the analysis runs, FFmpeg, or Chrome Headless Shell for the effects; or a link's video, named by its title, and yt-dlp, which fetches it.

name.description: The model, as its repository names it, the program, or the video's title.

step.description: The analysis's step for the file named, in the order vework takes them: reading it, shots, speech (voice activity), loudness, audio events, faces, removing noise from the speech, transcribing, correcting the transcript and timing its words; music for a track's analysis. A step vework has nothing to do for is skipped.

ShortNumber.description: With --shorts, the short the line is about: the nth of those to make.

ShortProgress.description: With --shorts, a short finished: shorts.json already lists it.

musicSkipped.description: Why the video plays no music although Claude chose a library track: its audio could not be downloaded or did not match its SHA-256. The edit is otherwise whole.

beatsSkipped.description: Which music tracks the person gave were analysed without beats, and why: the beat model could not be downloaded. Their music plays from the track's start, not fitted to its bars, and B-roll is not cut on its beats. The edit is otherwise whole.

outputs.description: Absolute paths of what the run wrote.

captions.description: The SubRip file, when the project asks for one.

music.description: The licence of each music track the video plays, when it plays music.

broll.description: Where each piece of B-roll and each sound effect the video plays came from, when it plays any with a credit.

ShortsDoneProgress.description: With --shorts, the last line of a run that made at least one short.

ClaudeCost.description: What Claude cost by stage: finding the moments of a --shorts run, planning, writing and fixing the motion graphics, and the review after each render with the decisions it escalates. A --shorts run sums its shorts, those given up on included. On the done line, a short's line, and an error line once a request was made.

dollars.description: US dollars at list price; null when a model's price is unknown.
